body.text: The Supreme Court declined this morning to hear the carry-licence reciprocity case, Johnson v. Jacobson, and the under-21 carry case, Salas-Martinez v. Texas.

The Court's first order list of the term (read at source) denies both, with no noted dissent; 48 of 57 gun petitions from the 9/28 conference were denied and none granted. Nothing about carrying across state lines changes today.

facts.title: 1. AR-15 cases lead term previews; NJ asks to ride along
3. SCOTUS denies reciprocity, under-21 carry petitions

body.text:
• Johnson v. Jacobson denied (carry reciprocity); rules unchanged
• 48 of 57 gun petitions denied, none granted; Novotny, Calce pending
• Late find: 5th Cir. struck federal direct interstate handgun-buy ban (9/18)
• New Jersey asks SCOTUS to hold its rifle/magazine case for AR-15 ruling
